prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: an orthographic BACK VIEW albedo texture-paint source for an existing 3D decoration, not a beauty render.
Output exactly ONE image, native 1024 x 1024 pixels, RGBA with a genuinely transparent background.

INPUTS AND AUTHORITY:
1. guide_back.png: EDIT TARGET. This plain gray back-view render is the absolute authority for the camera, silhouette, positions, size, outline, every shape edge, every opening and every geometric detail. Paint this exact image in place. Preserve its alpha silhouette pixel for pixel and all geometry. Do not redraw, reshape, smooth, expand, crop, rotate, reframe or reposition the model.
2. design_reference.png: MATERIAL, COLOR AND DESIGN REFERENCE ONLY. Its three-quarter camera and silhouette must NOT replace the target back-view geometry.
3. concept_crop.png: supporting original concept reference.

PRIMARY REQUEST:
Paint the surface materials from design_reference onto the EXACT shape in guide_back. This is the Spike cluster viewed from the BACK. Apply glossy black-violet resin lattice material, faint glowing orange interior seams and sacs where appropriate within the guide's existing forms, and ivory bone points with subtle natural ivory grain and fine warm seams matching the approved design. Keep the guide's actual faceted edges and pointed tips exactly in place. Express the design reference's materials through base color and fine painted surface detail without changing geometry or creating new cutouts. Color every part of the gray model. Preserve every opening and the existing transparent area exactly.

GEOMETRY LOCK:
The 1024-square guide object extends approximately from x117 to x906 and y66 to y957. The tallest central tip is near (494,66), left tip near (313,358), right tip near (683,449). Keep those positions, all three unequal tip heights, all angular protrusions and all rooted base edges exactly as the guide. The bottom remains in its original position. The output must register perfectly when laid over guide_back.png.

LIGHTING:
TEXTURE SOURCE / ALBEDO. Even, flat, shadowless illumination from the viewer. No cast shadows, no ambient-occlusion darkening, no directional shading, no strong specular highlights or reflections, no rim light. The resin's glossy material identity is in its color and detail, not baked lighting. Paint the orange interiors at their faint emissive orange color only, with NO orange light cast onto adjacent material, NO bloom, and NO halo.

BACKGROUND / CONSTRAINTS:
True alpha transparency only. No opaque black or white background, no checkerboard painted into the image, no floor, no shadow beneath the base, no scene, no captions. Nothing added outside the guide silhouette; nothing cropped. Preserve original 1024x1024 framing and silhouette exactly.

prompt:
CORRECTIVE GENERATION, the single correction allowed for this back view. Produce ONE native 1024 x 1024 PNG with alpha transparency. Exactly 1024 pixels wide and 1024 pixels tall, matching the edit target's pixel dimensions. Do not return 1254 x 1254. This is a technical texture-paint overlay, NOT an illustration or a lit presentation render.

Image 1, guide_back.png, is the 1024 x 1024 EDIT TARGET. Recolor ONLY the existing opaque pixels in this image. Preserve its exact alpha mask, angular silhouette, every shape edge and opening, positions and scale. KEEP THE GEOMETRY PIXEL-ALIGNED. No smoothing or reinterpretation. The top tip is at (494,66), left tip at (313,358), right tip at (683,449). The entire rooted base and its sharp edges stay exactly as shown at y958, extending from x117 to x907. These locations are in the final 1024-square image. Keep all internal structural edges and the BACK orthographic camera.

Image 2, design_reference.png, supplies colors and surface materials ONLY; it must not supply geometry, camera, shape or lighting.
Image 3, concept_crop.png, is the original concept, supporting material identity only.

Paint the exact gray guide using the approved glossy black-violet resin lattice material, faint orange glowing interiors, and ivory bone points. Ivory natural bone on the pointed upper caps; black-violet resin along the guide's existing ribbing and rooted base; faint orange within the existing inner forms. Material detail stays within the guide's existing geometry. No additional holes, spikes, ornamental projections or new silhouette features.

CRITICAL CORRECTION: FLAT ALBEDO ONLY. Even shadowless frontal illumination, uniform material visibility. Remove the strong shiny white reflections, rim highlights and dark occlusion shading seen in the previous attempt. No specular spots, no directional lighting, no cast shadows, no ambient occlusion, no black shadows in creases. Glossy resin identity is supplied by its violet-black material color and subtle fine texture, without rendering glossy lighting. Orange is faint painted emissive color, not bright fire; no bloom and no light spilled onto adjacent surfaces.

Genuinely transparent background, no floor or ground shadow. Keep the source guide's native 1024x1024 canvas and every alpha edge unchanged. Deliver the image at that exact resolution, with no crop, scale, or repositioning.
